videos.name: Y Combinator
videos.title: Tennr is AI that Gets Patients Seen
videos.description:
Tennr (YC W23) is building an AI-powered platform that gathers medical records and coordinates referrals to get patients to treatment faster, with fewer insurance denials. The company processed more than 10 million patients in the last year and now has a network of 430,000 referring providers.

In this episode of Founder Firesides, founder and CEO Trey Holterman talks with YC’s Gustaf Alströmer about nearly giving up after 16 ideas, stepping away from coding to listen to customers, and walking away from three-quarters of the business to focus on referrals. He also covers reliable healthcare AI and selling to providers—from understanding incentives to earning trust and getting software live.

https://www.tennr.com

Chapters:
00:00 — Inside Healthcare’s Referral Black Hole
04:11 — Finding the Problem in Primary Care
07:21 — How Tennr Gets Patients to Care
10:51 — Two Years in the Startup Wilderness
14:05 — 16 Ideas and One Last Shot at YC
17:52 — Why the CEO Stopped Coding
20:53 — Moving to New York and Finding Traction
24:04 — Walking Away From 75% of the Business
27:59 — Earning Trust With Customers and Investors
31:52 — Why Good Software Struggles in Healthcare
35:15 — Network Effects and the EMR Problem
38:49 — Why Better Models Aren’t Enough for Healthcare
42:58 — Learning Enterprise Sales From Scratch
45:58 — Finding the Buyer and Building a Champion
48:59 — Pricing and Getting Customers Live
